throughput_negotiation_summary: Goal: negotiated throughput guarantee for dedicated pool covering steady-state and burst windows
Min guaranteed throughput: propose 20,000 tokens/sec sustained (24/7) across the dedicated pool; Sundial countered at 15k sustained
Concurrency cap: define per-customer soft cap 600 concurrent sessions (soft cap => intelligent throttling + queued bursts)
Burst policy: allow staged bursts up to 120k tokens/sec for max 30s per minute, with a rolling 1-hour aggregate cap
Billing for bursts: hybrid model — included burst credit (e.g., 10M tokens/month) + overage at fixed per-token rate for additional bursts
Penalty / remediation: service credits if 95th pct latency > target or sustained tokens/sec below guaranteed for >10 minutes — tiered credits (5%/10%/20%) based on outage severity
Ramp & reservation schedule: 3-phase GPU reservation — Q1 reserve 40 GPUs (A100 equiv), Q2 +20, Q3 scale to peak based on telemetry; purchase windows tied to signed MSA
Fallbacks: automated routing to compatible model variants in hosted pool when dedicated pool constrained; customer requires explicit opt-in for fallback
Monitoring SLAs: token-level telemetry and per-route latency/queue-length dashboards delivered via Console; monthly review and capacity planning cadence
Open negotiation points: exact burst window sizing, how credits are calculated, and whether spot/interruptible GPUs acceptable for part of reserved pool
